title: Tailwise Autoship Courtesy on a Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus Overdue Fee
content:
An Autoship courtesy — a flat dollar amount — is subtracted from the overdue fee collected to reinstate a past-due Tailwise Plus Annual or Tailwise Plus Premier Annual membership of **Pals Rewards and Tailwise Plus**, according to the charged shipments that the customer's Tailwise Autoship subscriptions carry dated in the last three months.

| Charged Tailwise Autoship shipments dated in the last three months | Autoship courtesy |
|---|---|
| 3 or more | $2.00 |
| 1 or 2 | $1.00 |
| none | none |

Shipments of all the customer's Tailwise Autoship subscriptions are counted together.

**Edges (hypothetical).** 0 shipments: none; 1: $1.00; 2: $1.00; 3: $2.00.
